author: Bobby Grayson
description: Timers are untimed, so this is the model's over-approximation: along any fair run every worker the watchdog waits on is eventually killed and replaced, hung or healthy. The BEAM only kills workers whose pong is late.
title: hung_worker_replaced states exactly the requested hypotheses (worker alive and hung, WeakFair (.run w)) but neither is used: worker_replaced needs only TimerFair 0 .timeout, WeakFair .signal, WeakFair (.run 0) and a Good start, because the kill is untrappable and does not need w to run. The unused hypotheses are named _hw/_hrunw to keep the build warning-free
